senses.gloss: m. (b. h.) b’dolaḥ, name of a jewel, also of a gum, bdellium.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 16">Gen. R. s. 16</cite>, beg. <he>את סבור כב׳ וכ׳</he> you might think, b’dolaḥ (<cite ref="Genesis 2:12">Gen. II, 12</cite>) means the druggists’ bdellium—let its neighbor (next word <he>אבן השוהם</he>) explain it (correct. acc. to <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 21">Yalk. Gen. 21</cite>).
